archimate:Outcome.name: Increased Provider Confidence and Patient Trust in Care Quality
archimate:Outcome.documentation:
Clinical decision support tools provide healthcare providers with reliable and evidence-based recommendations during patient consultations. This strengthens transparency and consistency in healthcare delivery.
The purpose of this outcome is to improve provider confidence in clinical decision-making and increases patient trust in treatment recommendations. It also encourages greater adherence to approved care standards and protocols.
Example: Patients are more confident in treatment plans when clinicians reference nationally approved medical guidelines during consultations.
